title: Demo run: corridor survey and replanning
summary: The drone surveys an uncertain corridor, finds a scarp, the first route is invalidated and the astronaut is replanned around it, reaches goal B and returns to base.
disclaimer: Terrain: NASA/USGS CTX DTM crop (real, provisional). Mission, budgets and the corridor scarp are simulated or synthetic; POIs are fictitious. Not EVA-certified limits, not a planner output.

ai_disclosure.scope: Fixture generator script and replay fixture structure; the simulated mission, routes and events are generated data, not observations.
ai_disclosure.observational_data: Only the terrain heights come from NASA/USGS data; everything else here is simulated.

imagery.title: MRO CTX Jezero orthomosaic, controlled (Mars 2020 TRN)
imagery.source: JPL Mars Trek WMTS layer JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008_orthoMosaic_6m_Eqc_latTs0_lon0, https://trek.nasa.gov/mars/
imagery.processing: Bilinear resampling onto the crop ENU grid; display contrast stretched linearly between the 1st and 99th percentile. Panchromatic; the viewer tints it for display only.

terrain_meta.crs: Local tangent ENU grid; source Equirectangular, Mars 2000 sphere IAU (R = 3396190 m)
terrain_meta.vertical_datum: MOLA areoid; local z = elevation - (-2495 m)
sources: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM mosaic, USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA. File JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008_DTM_MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid_20m_Eqc_latTs0_lon0.tif, 9662387 bytes, SHA-256 16a1aa66c3f48c1bca252795827db7b417876217aff0f5e1aff18027fab2327b.

Product page https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/mars_2020_terrain_relative_navigation_ctx_dtm_mosaic (DOI family https://doi.org/10.5066/P906QQT8). Native resolution 20 m. Not verified here: USGS-hosted NASA planetary data, see the product page for usage terms.

Crop: 100 x 100 cells of 20 m centred at 18.53545 N, 77.42382 E, bilinear resampling onto a local tangent ENU grid (east = R cos(lat) dlon, north = R dlat); same cell size as the source, so no resolution gain. PROVISIONAL, made by the frontend until the data owner delivers the processed package.
SYNTHETIC: a scarp was added to the hidden evaluator reference to create an adverse case. It does not exist in the CTX data.
ILLUSTRATIVE: uncertainty (sigma), budgets, speeds and consumption rates are assumptions of a simulated mission.
